experiment.objective: Proposed: Characterize the liquid process stream and identify the contaminant or quality variable to enable method selection.
samples: Proposed: Representative on-specification liquid process stream samples
Proposed: Representative off-specification liquid process stream samples (if available)
measurements: Proposed: Independent laboratory reference measurements to identify the contaminant or quality variable
Proposed: Spectral measurements of the liquid process stream using a broad-spectrum technique (e.g., NIR, MIR, Raman) to establish a baseline
Proposed: pair spectra and independent laboratory references at aligned sample locations and times; confirm assay identity, uncertainty and sampling lag with the customer.
comparisons: Proposed: agree measurable quality variables and independent reference characterization before selecting candidate methods.
experiment.validation: Proposed: agree independent experimental units before testing.
experiment.decision_criteria: Proposed: Go/no-go proposal: proceed only if evaluation on independent material meets agreed customer-defined error, bias, response time and robustness criteria. Missing thresholds remain open; inconclusive results require clarification or further characterization.
variation: Proposed: Process variation (e.g., temperature, flow rate, composition) to be characterized and controlled
